authoritative_sources.label: 3M / Solventum — AP900 Series whole house systems spec (AP902/AP903/AP904)
claims: Each AP902, AP903, AP904 is a single-cartridge whole-house system (one head + one cartridge).
AP902 ships/includes standard replacement AP910R (5621001) — particulate; non-woven pleat media; 5 µm nominal; not described as carbon block.
AP903 ships/includes standard replacement AP917HD (5621006) — particulate + chlorine taste & odor; carbon block with non-woven pleat media.
AP904 ships/includes standard replacement AP917HD-S (5621008) — particulate + CT&O + scale inhibition; carbon block with pleat + scale media.
Comparison table pairs one system model to one standard replacement cartridge only.
Capacity ~100,000 gallons (~one year under typical conditions) at AP900 series level.

authoritative_sources.label: 3M / Lenntech mirror — AP902/AP903 data sheet excerpt
claims: Confirms single-cartridge AP902 (AP910R) and AP903 (AP917HD) systems.
AP917HD-S documented as replacement cartridge with scale inhibition (AP904 class), not AP903 in-box cartridge.
AP910R: non-woven blended pleat media; AP917HD: carbon block + pleat; AP917HD-S: carbon block + pleat + scale inhibition.

authoritative_sources.label: Solventum product page — AP917HD cartridge
claims: AP917HD (5621006) manufactured for AP903 system.
Activated carbon block with nominal 5 µm particulate; reduces sediment and chlorine taste/odor.

authoritative_sources.label: 3M regional product page — AP910R cartridge
claims: AP910R (5621001) Sanitary Quick-Change cartridge for AP902 system.
Particulate / pleat-class cartridge — not marketed as carbon block.

claims: Primary part on file: AP910R with carbon naming and 12-month interval.
Model notes reference dual-stage AP917HD-S + AP910R.
Both AP910R and AP917HD-S appear as recommended mapped parts.
